prompt.project_info: Create an authentic quiet-afternoon bedroom portrait beside a window.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with cool light-brown straight hair, minimal makeup, fair cool skin with realistic pores, and inward calm gaze, wearing an opaque deep-grey long-sleeve lounge dress or top with relaxed trousers.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium-full vertical 9:16 portrait, seated casually on a bed with one leg bent and one extended, natural asymmetrical posture, wooden bed frame, white bedding, beige knitted blanket, muted-green wall and simple TV stand.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft directional window daylight with smooth shadow transitions, quiet afternoon stillness, realistic social-media lifestyle photography.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone lifestyle portrait, slight high angle, moderate depth, natural digital grain and realistic detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An authentic 9:16 lifestyle portrait of an approved adult woman with cool light-brown straight hair, natural middle part, minor flyaways, fair cool skin with realistic pores, minimal makeup, and a calm inward gaze lowered toward her lap. She wears an opaque deep-grey long-sleeve lounge dress or top with relaxed trousers and sits casually on a bed with one leg bent and one extended. The bedroom has a wooden bed frame, white bedding, beige knitted blanket, muted light-green wall, and simple TV stand. Use soft directional window daylight, smooth shadows, natural posture, moderate depth, subtle digital grain, and quiet afternoon stillness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, lingerie, bralette, lace underwear, thin straps, exposed midriff, sexualized private moment, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
